symbols.name: load_farming_references
symbols.doc: Small reviewed Q&A entries with source URLs; indexed alongside GR pages.

symbols.name: load_corpus
symbols.doc: Load PDFs directly, plus curated HTML/CSV, without duplicate PDF exports.

symbols.name: get_session
symbols.doc:
FastAPI dependency: yields a session and always releases it.

Rolls back on any exception so a failed request never leaves a
half-written transaction on a pooled connection.

symbols.name: check_database
symbols.doc: Lightweight connectivity probe used by the /health endpoint.

symbols.name: ensure_legacy_columns
symbols.doc:
Add any missing columns to tables that already exist.

Uses the SQLAlchemy inspector so it works on SQLite and PostgreSQL alike.
Failures are logged rather than raised so a migration hiccup can never
prevent the API from starting.

symbols.name: translate_text
symbols.doc:
Translate text, returning the original if translation is unavailable.

Translation uses the configured local/API service; a timeout must never
turn a good answer into a server error.

symbols.name: health_check
symbols.doc: Report database, vector index and checked model readiness honestly.

symbols.name: _related_sources
symbols.doc: Show strongly related evidence honestly when the requested fact is missing.

symbols.name: _generate
symbols.doc: Use a bounded model call to select evidence, never manufacture facts.

symbols.name: _is_clean_sentence
symbols.doc: Reject fragments and garbled OCR/PDF output so they never reach users.

symbols.name: OllamaClient
symbols.doc:
Minimal Ollama client with a cached availability probe.

The probe stops every request from waiting for the full generation timeout
when Ollama simply isn't running.

symbols.name: answer
symbols.doc:
Return source excerpts only; model output is never treated as evidence.

Cache is bounded and scoped to the retrieval-relevant profile. The index
and cache share a lifetime, so rebuilding the index invalidates answers.
Confidence describes lexical relevance, not factual correctness.

symbols.name: _valid_target_script
symbols.doc: Hindi and Marathi share a script; the language heuristic cannot validate them.

symbols.name: groq_translate
symbols.doc: Translate only supplied evidence; reject numeric or citation changes.
